The Story

TRADER.
MENTOR.
SURVIVOR.

Justin — The Bear of Wall Street — didn’t come from finance. He was a nurse until a severe brain injury forced him to start over from nothing. He was told his ceiling was low. He decided that wasn’t the plan.

Years of obsession later, he found his edge: shorting small-cap pumps that go up fast and come right back down. Not signals. Not hype. A repeatable process, real risk management, and the discipline to follow it every day — verified, on camera.

TBOWS exists to hand that structure to traders who are serious about getting better — and to build a community that actually pushes each other forward.
